method: 5x5 catcher view. px/pz feet, +px = 1B (catcher's right). Columns: chase | three plate thirds (17in) | chase; pitches outside clamp to the edge bin. Rows: that pitch's strikeZoneInchesBottom/Top (else 1.5–3.5 ft) as thirds plus one chase row above and below; row 0 is up. Hitter maps split on pitcherInfo.pitchingSide. Pitcher maps split on batterInfo.battingSide. SLG = TB/AB on the terminal pitch of the PA only (Synergy copies plateAppearanceResult onto every pitch). Whiff = (StrikeSwinging+FoulTip+MissedBunt) / swings.
colors: blue low, green mid, red high
